# NEXT WORKOUT: DYNAMIC PUSH SESSION (14-DAY RECOVERY • INTERLEAVED UPPER CHEST, DUAL LATERALS & LONG-HEAD TRICEPS)

Interleaves Lateral Delts & Overhead Triceps between every chest movement so zero chest sets stack back-to-back, includes feeler sets for >14d layoffs, and prioritizes stretch-mediated long-head triceps.*

---

## COACHING BRIEFING & PROTOCOLS

### 1. Real-Time Synthesis Rationale (Why These 6 Exercises Today)
- **Zero Back-to-Back Chest Stacking**: Every chest movement (`Incline DB` → `Smith Bench` → `Pec Deck`) is separated by Lateral Raises and Overhead Triceps so pecs clear local fatigue instead of crashing like Oct 19 (-45% Pec Deck drop).
- **Dual-Profile Lateral Delts (Tier-1 Priority)**: Since Push frequency has averaged once every 14 days, both **Cable Lateral Raise** (lengthened bottom stretch) and **DB Lateral Raise** (shortened top peak + drop set) are included for 6+1 sets.
- **Long-Head Triceps Priority**: Replaces Pushdowns with **Overhead Cable Triceps Extension** (your hottest Nov 14 PR at 20 kg × 10, 8, 7) because overhead stretch drives ~2/3 of triceps mass when pressing frequency is low.
- **Layoff Feeler Guardrail**: Incline DB (14d gap) requires a **17.5 kg × 4** feeler set; Smith Bench (40d gap) requires a **32.5 kg × 5** feeler set before working weights.

### 2. Equipment & Intensity Guardrails
- **NO 6.0 kg DB in Gym**: Rack jumps 5.0 kg → 7.0 kg (+40%). Stay strictly on **5.0 kg DBs** for DB Lateral Raises (12–15+ reps, 2s negative) + Set 3 drop set to **2.5 kg**.
- **+5.0 kg Cable Stack Increments**: Stay on **20.0 kg** on Overhead Triceps Ext until you conquer 12+ reps across sets.
- **RIR Standards**: Stop compounds (Incline DB, Smith Bench) at **1–2 RIR**. Push isolations (Cable/DB Lateral Raise, Overhead Ext, Pec Deck) to **0–1 RIR**.

### 3. Gym Duration Guardrail: 50–55 Minutes Max
- **16 Working Sets Total**: Rest **150 sec** on Incline DB & Smith Bench, **60–90 sec** on Lateral Raises, Overhead Triceps, and Pec Deck.

---

## WORKOUT BLUEPRINT & EXERCISE TARGETS

### 1. Incline Dumbbell Bench Press (30° Bench)
- **Order Rationale**: **#1 Clavicular Upper-Chest Anchor.** Executed first while CNS and front delts are 100% fresh after 14 days rest.
- **Working Sets**: **3 sets x 6–10 (Set 1) / 8–12 (Sets 2–3) reps** | Rest: 150 sec | Target RIR: **1–2**
- **Target Weight**: **22.5 kg top-set / 20.0 kg back-off (per hand)**
  - *Mandatory Warm-Up Ramp*: 12.5 kg × 10 reps, then **17.5 kg × 4 feeler reps** (wakes up CNS before 22.5 kg).
  - *Main Target*: Set 1 @ **22.5 kg × 8–10 reps** (beat Nov 14's 6 reps); Sets 2–3 @ **20.0 kg × 10–12 reps**.
  - *Stretch Target*: 22.5 kg × 10 reps on Set 1 + 22.5 kg × 8–9 reps on Set 2 (matching Oct 19 PR).
- **Gym Floor Swap Option**: If adjustable benches are full, start with **Smith Machine Bench Press** (#3) or use **Incline Machine Chest Press** (35.0–45.0 kg).
- **Form Cue**: Set bench strictly to **30° (second notch)**—never 45°. Tuck elbows **45°–60°** from torso, lower DBs to outer upper-chest stretch for 2 seconds, drive up smoothly without clacking weights at top.
- **Mind-Muscle Cue**: Pin shoulder blades **down and back into the bench** before unracking. Think about sweeping your biceps inward across your collarbone shelf rather than pushing your hands away.

---

### 2. Cable Lateral Raise
- **Order Rationale**: **#2 Lengthened-Range Lateral Delt Priority & Active Chest Recovery.** Gives pecs/triceps 6–8 minutes of metabolic clearance before Smith Bench while loading the medial delt in the bottom stretch.
- **Working Sets**: **3 sets x 12–15 reps** | Rest: 60–90 sec | Target RIR: **0–1**
- **Target Weight**: **2.5 kg pin (Master 3 × 15 before jumping to 5.0 kg)**
  - *Main Target*: 2.5 kg × 14, 13, 12+ reps per arm (beat Nov 14's 3×12; chase Oct 16's 16-rep PR).
  - *Stretch Target*: 2.5 kg × 15, 15, 15 reps with strict 2-second eccentric return.
- **Gym Floor Swap Option**: If cable stack is occupied, swap order with **Smith Machine Bench Press** (#3) or perform single-arm **Leaning DB Lateral Raise** (5.0 kg DB).
- **Form Cue**: Set pulley to **wrist/hip height**, cable crossing in front of thighs (or behind back). Stand tall, hold upright support lightly with non-working hand, sweep arm out in the scapular plane (15° forward) to shoulder height, and control a 2-second negative without letting the weight stack clank.
- **Mind-Muscle Cue**: Depress your shoulder blade **down into your back pocket** before every rep. Think about dragging your **wrist/knuckles toward the opposite wall**, keeping your pinky level with your thumb.

---

### 3. Smith Machine Bench Press (Flat)
- **Order Rationale**: **#3 Refreshed Sternal Chest Mechanical Tension.** Re-establishes flat pressing strength after a 40-day layoff while pecs and triceps are cleared of incline-press fatigue.
- **Working Sets**: **2 sets x 6–8 reps** | Rest: 150 sec | Target RIR: **1–2**
- **Target Weight**: **42.5 kg – 47.5 kg total (bar + plates)**
  - *Mandatory Layoff Feeler*: **32.5 kg × 5 reps** (40 days since Oct 19—groove the bar path first).
  - *Main Target*: Set 1 @ **47.5 kg × 6–7 reps** (matching Oct 19 PR); Set 2 @ **42.5 kg × 8–10 reps**.
  - *Stretch Target*: 47.5 kg × 8, 7 reps across both working sets.
- **Gym Floor Swap Option**: If Smith machine is taken, execute **Flat Barbell Bench Press** (37.5–42.5 kg) or **Seated Chest Press Machine** (40.0–45.0 kg) for 2 × 8–10 reps.
- **Form Cue**: Align bench so the bar touches your **lower sternum / nipple line** at the bottom. Plant feet flat into the floor, keep chest proud, and lower under a 2-second controlled descent without bouncing off the chest.
- **Mind-Muscle Cue**: Imagine trying to **bend the bar inward** and squeeze your elbows together across your lower chest as you press. Keep shoulders depressed away from your ears.

---

### 4. Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
- **Order Rationale**: **#4 Stretch-Mediated Long-Head Triceps Priority.** Placed before Pec Deck so chest recovers completely while you drive maximal growth in the triceps long head (~2/3 of upper-arm triceps mass).
- **Working Sets**: **3 sets x 8–12 reps** | Rest: 90 sec | Target RIR: **0–1**
- **Target Weight**: **20.0 kg pin (Master 12+ reps before +5 kg jump to 25.0 kg)**
  - *Main Target*: 20.0 kg × 11, 9, 8 reps (beat Nov 14's 10, 8, 7).
  - *Stretch Target*: 20.0 kg × 12, 10, 9 reps with full behind-head stretch.
- **Gym Floor Swap Option**: If overhead cable station is occupied, perform **Cable Triceps Pushdown** at 20.0 kg (3 × 12–15) or **Single-Arm Overhead DB Extension** (7.0–8.0 kg DB).
- **Form Cue**: Set cable at chest/shoulder height, face away in a staggered split stance, lean torso slightly forward. Keep upper arms angled overhead and **freeze elbows in space**—allow forearms to fold all the way behind your head for a 1-second deep stretch before extending cleanly.
- **Mind-Muscle Cue**: Feel the **back-underside of your upper arm (long head near the armpit)** stretch tight at the bottom of every rep, then drive your hands forward without flaring elbows outward.

---

### 5. Dumbbell Lateral Raise (+ Set 3 Drop Set)
- **Order Rationale**: **#5 Shortened-Range Lateral Delt Overload & Active Chest Breather.** Complements Cable Laterals by peaking tension at the top of the arc while giving chest extra recovery before Pec Deck.
- **Working Sets**: **3 sets x 12–15 reps (Set 3 drops immediately to 2.5 kg x 10–15)** | Rest: 60–90 sec | Target RIR: **0–1**
- **Target Weight**: **5.0 kg per hand (Drop set: 2.5 kg per hand)**
  - *Main Target*: 5.0 kg × 15, 13, 12 reps → immediate Drop Set: 2.5 kg × 12+ reps.
  - *Equipment Guardrail*: **NO 6.0 kg DB exists** and 7.0 kg (+40%) causes trap shrugging—earn overload via strict 2-second negatives and high-rep density at 5.0 kg.
- **Gym Floor Swap Option**: If 5.0 kg DBs are taken, run 3 burnout sets on **Cable Lateral Raise** (2.5 kg) with a 1-second pause at peak abduction.
- **Form Cue**: Lean torso forward ~10–15°. Raise arms in the **scapular plane (15°–30° forward of your sides)**, stopping strictly at **collarbone/shoulder height**. Zero torso swing or knee bounce.
- **Mind-Muscle Cue**: **Pocket your shoulder blades down** before rep 1. Reach your **knuckles outward toward the far walls** (not upward toward the ceiling) and pull your elbows apart like stretching a tight elastic band.

---

### 6. Pec Deck Machine Fly
- **Order Rationale**: **#6 Pure Pectoral Isolation & Peak Contraction Finisher.** Chest is refreshed after Overhead Triceps and DB Laterals so you finish with strong squeeze instead of post-bench rep collapse.
- **Working Sets**: **2 sets x 10–12 reps** | Rest: 90 sec | Target RIR: **0–1**
- **Target Weight**: **35.0 kg pin (Fallback: 30.0 kg pin)**
  - *Main Target*: 35.0 kg × 12, 12 reps (consolidating Nov 14's 12, 11).
  - *Stretch Target*: 35.0 kg × 13, 12 reps with a 1-second peak contraction pause on every rep.
- **Gym Floor Swap Option**: If Pec Deck is busy, execute **Standing Cable Chest Fly** (set pulleys at shoulder height, 5.0–7.5 kg per side) for 2 × 12–15 reps.
- **Form Cue**: Set seat height so handles align directly with **mid-chest**. Keep elbows softly bent at a fixed angle (do not turn the fly into a press). Control a **3-second eccentric stretch** back until handles align with torso, then sweep smoothly inward.
- **Mind-Muscle Cue**: Lead the inward sweep with your **inner elbows and wrists together**, not your hands. Hold a hard **1-second squeeze** when knuckles meet in front of your sternum.
